data.narrative:
Ambrosia Energy is a Growth-stage private company in Climate & Energy, founded by Ben Longmier and Sara Spangelo. The addressable comp universe consists of one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, this universe lacks sufficient homogeneity for traditional benchmarking.

Peer-median valuation analysis is not applicable here. The Climate & Energy sector contains eight same-sector comparables, but when filtered to same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier criteria, the dataset yields fewer than three datapoints in any single category. A peer-median approach using the broader all-sector median would introduce material distortion given the heterogeneity of business models, capital intensity, and maturity profiles across the available set. Consequently, the primary triangulation method cannot be executed with confidence.

Given these constraints, this valuation is anchored to qualitative stage and sector positioning rather than quantitative triangulation. Ambrosia Energy's Growth-stage classification and operations in the capital-intensive Climate & Energy sector suggest valuation ranges consistent with mid-to-late venture equity rounds, but determination of a specific range requires either (1) access to recent funding data for the company itself, (2) additional proprietary comp analysis, or (3) cost-of-capital and unit economics modeling that is not present in the available dataset. The key uncertainty is the absence of tight, stage-matched comparables against which to benchmark.
